scope: full spec-to-code verification across all 8 changed files

fixVerification.finding: useAiJobApplicationSummary fired for non-succeeded statuses when a summary existed
fixVerification.fix: PlatoTab.tsx line 40 changed from `aiJobApplicationSummaryId: aiSummary?.id || 0` to `aiJobApplicationSummaryId: (status === "succeeded" && aiSummary?.id) || 0`
fixVerification.analysis: The fix correctly gates the fetch ID on status === "succeeded". When status is anything other than succeeded, aiJobApplicationSummaryId resolves to 0, and the hook's enabled guard (`!!aiJobApplicationSummaryId && aiJobApplicationSummaryId > 0`) prevents the query from firing. The structuredData access at line 43 also guards on status === "succeeded", providing defense in depth.
